subject: Renewal true-up: proposed split-wire settlement + VAT evidence
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@riosystems.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@riosystems.com
Date: 2026-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal true-up and final invoice request

Hi Markus & Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Per our records we exceeded our committed monthly throughput during July–August (burst credits applied) and need a final true-up invoice for the renewal term so our AP team can close the PO. Can you provide: a) a single final invoice showing the true-up line (usage delta) and b) confirmation on VAT handling — Rio Systems EU will need either a VAT-inclusive invoice or a reverse-charge statement depending on Redwood's tax approach.

Attached is the PO our procurement team expects to tie this settlement to (PO_6782.pdf). We are trying to avoid creating two separate invoices if possible but we can accept split wires if Redwood requires different legal entities to be invoiced.

Target for payment: week of Sep 20 if the invoice and VAT evidence are in order. Please advise the payment routing and whether we should expect any credits applied from the trial months.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Cloud Ops
Rio Systems

Attachments: PO_6782.pdf (PDF)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@riosystems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T08:52:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal true-up and final invoice request

Samantha — thanks for the note and the PO. We can absolutely get a final true-up out to you. Quick outline so we align:

- We can issue either a single consolidated invoice billed to Rio Systems, with a bundled VAT line (if Redwood is charging VAT), or two invoices so each Rio legal entity is billed and accepts local VAT treatments.
- Our proposed path (to avoid AP reconciliation headaches) is: split the settlement into two wire movements tied to one consolidated invoice; the invoice will include clear ledger lines for the portion attributable to Rio EU vs Rio US and a net due amount per wire.
- To support reverse-charge for the EU portion we will need Rio's VAT registration/TIN and a signed reverse-charge attestation — if you can send Rio_TIN.pdf and the DocuSign link we can attach that to the invoice.
- We will also allocate any credits from the trial period against the true-up and list them as a single-credit line so your AP has a simple remit amount.

Can you confirm: 1) the legal entity names for the two wires, 2) bank details for the two wires (or confirm one wire to Redwood US and one to Redwood EU), and 3) whether Rio prefers an escrow hold on 10% until VAT residency is confirmed (some EU customers request this; flagging as optional).

I will loop in Accounting to generate the Settlement Matrix and draft invoice once we have the TIN and wire routing.

—Markus
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@riosystems.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal true-up and final invoice request

Hi Samantha — following Markus' note, attaching a proposed payment schedule and settlement matrix for AP (Settlement_Matrix.xlsx). Key points from accounting:

- Proposed split: 70% of the true-up allocated to Rio Systems EU (eligible for reverse-charge) and 30% to Rio Systems Inc (US).
- Invoice will show: base subscription, true-up usage delta, trial credits, and two remit rows indicating amount and legal entity.
- If Rio provides VAT TIN and signed reverse-charge, we will mark the EU line as reverse-charge and set VAT = 0 for that line; otherwise we must charge VAT at Redwood's local rate and the full remit will be higher.
- Accounting prefers to receive the two wire instructions as separate bank details (one for Redwood EU ledger, one for Redwood US ledger) — if you must supply a single bank with an allocation note that is workable but creates extra bookkeeping.

Next steps: once we receive Rio_TIN.pdf and confirmation of wire account names we'll generate the draft invoice (PDF) and email it for review. We can also push a DocuSign envelope for the reverse-charge attestation if that helps AP.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Settlement_Matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Rio Systems Finance <finance@riosystems.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@riosystems.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal true-up and final invoice request

Laura — thanks, that breakdown works for us. Quick clarifications from Rio AP:

- Confirming legal entities for wires: Rio Systems Europe Ltd (for EU amount) and Rio Systems, Inc. (for US amount). We'll provide the IBAN and USD routing in a separate secure message.
- We can provide the VAT TIN and sign the reverse-charge DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/12345/RIO-vat-statement
- Proposed payment dates: 70% wire on Sep 22, 30% wire on Sep 29 (both subject to receiving the invoice and reverse-charge evidence).
- Attached is Rio_TIN.pdf for Redwood to validate.

We will expect the final invoice file (PDF) and a single accounting reference (your invoice number + PO_6782) so our ERP ties it to the PO. Please confirm whether Redwood will hold any retention — Rio prefers no holds but can agree to a 5% short-term hold until VAT attestation is processed.

Regards,
Rio Systems Finance

Attachments: Rio_TIN.pdf (PDF)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Rio Systems Finance <finance@riosystems.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@riosystems.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal true-up and final invoice request

All — thank you, this is actionable. Summary and next steps (final):

1) Redwood will produce a consolidated invoice (RIO_Final_Invoice_20345.pdf) that includes ledger-level lines and explicit wire remit rows for: Rio Systems Europe Ltd (70%) and Rio Systems, Inc. (30%). The PDF will reference PO_6782 and our invoice number RW-20345.
2) We will attach the signed reverse-charge attestation and Rio_TIN.pdf to the invoice package. With the TIN in place we will mark the EU line as reverse-charge (VAT = 0).
3) Payment schedule agreed: 70% on 2026-09-22, 30% on 2026-09-29. If Rio chooses to hold 5% short-term for verification please confirm; otherwise we will invoice the full net due and process receivable upon wires.
4) Vanessa, please raise the invoice in NetSuite and set the invoice terms to "Split-wire settlement — reference PO_6782". Attach Settlement_Matrix.xlsx and the DocuSign envelope link in the AR record.

Thanks everyone — I'll confirm once the invoice PDF is uploaded to HubSpot and Accounting has filed the AR entry.

—Markus
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments to follow: RIO_Final_Invoice_20345.pdf (PDF)
